title: Area-code org enumeration shard A pass 26

data.research_question: Which current or recent public anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable in shard-A NPAs 765, 771, 774 and 786?
data.method: Deterministic NPA shard-A enumeration using current numbering authority, literal area-code and organization-family queries, locality-derived searches, current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-lead checks, first-party/public-directory corroboration, and public organizational communications enumeration.
classification_rules: Use current in-service U.S. NANP geographic NPAs where integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
Historical directories and old event pages are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity without fresh corroboration.
Area-code relations represent locality/discovery geography and do not assert telephone-number ownership.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; do not merge organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
Preserve ideological characterization only when supported by organizational self-description or source evidence.
No private membership inference or person-level political/ideological affiliation profiling.

unresolved_leads: Muncie Food Not Bombs has strong September 2025 activity evidence but no independent 2026 first-party status confirmation was found in this bounded pass.
Additional Lafayette/Kokomo/Anderson mutual-aid leads lacked enough organization-level identity evidence for promotion.
Historical D.C. anarchist-infoshop leads were retained as historical discovery context and not promoted as current organizations without fresh status evidence.
Additional ward-level DC Mutual Aid Network nodes remain available for later organization-identity resolution.
Stone Soup Artist/Activist Collective is treated as the documented predecessor identity of The Village rather than silently duplicated as a current organization.
Historical Firecracker/Worcester Autonomy Center material lacked current-status evidence and was not promoted.
Additional South Florida mutual-aid projects surfaced but were left for distinct identity resolution rather than broadening this bounded pass.
